The pylon sign reads 'Versailles Restaurant / Cuban Cuisine'. Photo is ~18 years old, so I compared it against two newer Commons photos of the same address (2018 and June 2021, both also in this guide's candidate pool): the same cream balustraded roofline, arched windows and red awnings appear unchanged in all three, confirming the building still matches its 2008 appearance; year noted in the caption per the currency rule.
